title: Bayern Munich confirm Jamal Musiala's first squad selection in six months ahead of Champions League matchday two
summary: Bayern Munich have placed Jamal Musiala in their matchday squad for the first time since a long-term injury, with the German international expected to feature on Wednesday in the UEFA Champions League league-phase fixture against Atalanta at the Allianz Arena. Musiala has not played since the spring after a six-month absence and his return adds to Vincent Kompany's options alongside Harry Kane. Bayern opened the league phase with a 5-0 win at Bodø/Glimt on 10 September and sit third in the Bundesliga on goal difference behind Borussia Dortmund.
